_doc: midwest lane round 2 (2026-11-06). Same format as ramps.json. Even splits and exact months are Capstone ESTIMATES unless 'why' says sourced.

OH-JEFFERSONVILLE-AWSFAYETTE-P1.why: AES Ohio LAS 2024-11-25 Phase-1 ramp (65->480 MW, Sep-26 to Sep-27) superseded by AES LAS 2026-09-21: no large DC operating, DAY zone 75 MW Jul-27 / ~410 MW Jul-28 / 1,820 MW Jul-29; re-dated ramp is a Capstone estimate

OH-PIKETON-PORTSPIKE-P1.why: SB Energy S-1/A 2026-09-21: 17 buildings x ~472 MW IT (8,024 MW), leases commence in stages early 2028 to 2032 (first-phase RFS 2028, final RFS 2032); even annual split is a Capstone estimate

IN-NEWLEBANON-MERIDIAN-ALL.why: Fitch (relayed): first 65 MW hall Jul-2027; credit-workbook seed (unverified): lease commencements Aug-2027 to Feb-2028; even split is a Capstone estimate

IN-NWINDIANA-AWSNIPSCO-ALL.why: NIPSCO filing: service from 2027-01-01 rising to 2.4 GW by end-2032 (Apr-2026 amendment accelerated delivery, terms not public); even split is a Capstone estimate

IN-LAPORTE-MICROSOFT-ALL.why: NiSource 10-Q 2026-10-28: capacity commitment begins 2028, rises to 788 MW from 2031; even split is a Capstone estimate

MI-VANBURENTWP-GOOGLECANNOLI-ALL.why: MPSC 2026-10-01 citing DTE: service begins Dec-2027, maximum load Dec-2028; even split is a Capstone estimate

IL-JOLIET-JTC-ALL.why: Datacentres.com 2026-05-08: initial capacity by late 2027, phased over a decade; even split is a Capstone estimate

KY-HAWESVILLE-TERAWULF-JUSTIFIED.why: TeraWulf 8-K 2026-11-04 (Fluor EPC): phased RFS for three buildings from late 2027 through Q2-2028; even split is a Capstone estimate
